policy: Record Image to Text only after controlled English and Swahili images produce equivalent real local OCR, every advertised text export parses, same-origin OCR assets are distinguished from user-data egress, and queue/reset, privacy, mobile/reflow, themes, keyboard/accessibility and reciprocal metadata pass coordinator review.

evidence.workflow: The coordinator reviewed the generated native owner and reran its source contract plus 3/3 real Chromium OCR workflows. A synthetic image was recognized locally with equivalent English and Swahili OCR text; invalid input, two-image queue, cleanup reset, localized clipboard handoff and no persistence of pixels or recognized text passed.
evidence.export: TXT, Markdown, JSON and CSV downloads were parsed; JSON fields and raw OCR text were inspected. Tesseract worker, WASM and language GETs stayed same-origin, while any non-telemetry write or external data request remained fail-closed. Mobile/reflow, themes, keyboard/focus, canonical/OG/schema/hreflang and dedicated artwork passed.
